elements.text:
Put a /bSupercharged Diamond/z in the mortar and pestle and a /bWater Flask/z in the bottle slot, then crush.

  The diamond leaves its dust behind in the input slot, and the flask fills with /bLiquid Magic/z.

  A Water Flask is filled the same way a bottle is, by right clicking water or a full cauldron with a /bGlass Flask/z in hand.
